description: This file defines an abstract class 'ContentRepository' which declares methods for fetching home feed data, searching content, and retrieving content by ID in the OTT platform's frontend project.

classes.name: ContentRepository
classes.description: An abstract repository class for content-related data operations, defining the interface for fetching and retrieving content.

methods.name: fetchHomeFeed
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the home feed payload data.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for content items based on the provided query string.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a content item by its unique identifier, returning null if not found.
